isc_search_workflows._comment: Lab 49 policy: SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) search syntax subset, scheduled search report rules, workflow step catalog and event trigger catalog. The engine reads only this section.

concepts.search query: A Lucene-style query string (field:term joined by AND, OR, NOT) that ISC Search runs against indexed identities, access, accounts and events.
concepts.nested query: A query wrapped in @accounts(...) or @access(...) so that every condition inside must be true of the same account or access item.
concepts.scheduled search: A saved search that runs on a schedule and emails its results to chosen recipients, optionally skipping the email when nothing matches.
concepts.event trigger: A platform event, such as Identity Created, that ISC publishes so subscribed services or workflows can react to it.
concepts.subscription filter: A Jayway JSONPath expression on a trigger subscription; the subscriber is called only when the expression selects something from the event.
concepts.workflow: A no-code automation that starts from one trigger and runs actions and operators, with every branch finishing in an end step.
concepts.choice operator: A workflow step such as Compare Strings that sends the run down a true path or a false path, so both paths must be connected.
concepts.configuration backup: A snapshot of tenant configuration objects (sources, transforms, workflows and more) taken in Configuration Hub so a bad change can be compared and restored.
